purpose: Preserve failed operator diagnostics and prevent incomplete snapshots from qualifying reader claims. No model calls or model outcomes changed.

probes.cause: Exporting the additional modern repository with git archive exceeded its 30-second preparation deadline.
The replacement worktree inherited CI sparse exclusions. It materialized 4879 of 74505 tracked files, omitting 69626 archived result files. Its before-reader index exceeded 240 seconds.

The same partial snapshot scanned 2994 files and attempted 880043 reference resolutions. It reached 819200 at 235.896 seconds, then hit the 240-second deadline. These are diagnostic progress counts, not complete-corpus benchmark facts.
An explicit optimized build alone could not repair the inherited snapshot exclusions. Do not use its outputs as complete-source evidence.

repair: Materialize the explicitly selected complete Git tree with sparse checkout disabled; require every tracked input to exist before indexing. Build both semantic readers with the same recorded optimization. Preserve build300s, execution240s and job15m limits.
qualification_scope: Use both declared fixed benchmark corpora (e423fd2d03e5d74f2efea40b6ccd20812ac1178a and 3fdba43036f4fac2a6e73a659c5dbf7e907c48cf). The additional modern repository probe was not a qualified benchmark and supplies no reader-equivalence or speed result.
